{{Quote|I expected a market like that to be bigger on Coruscant. It should be kilometers long! I've seen bigger on itty-bitty worlds.|Aqualish assassin|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''Coruscant pedestrian market''' was a open market on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It contained numerous shops and stalls.<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the market was the site of an [[Attempted assassination on Garik Loran|attempted]] assassination on [[Garik Loran]], the leader of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit.<ref name="MK" />
